caveats: Experimental: requires Paseo 0.8, daemon Node >=22.19, and a separately installed official DSH with credentials.
Only DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 and 0.1.5-rc.2 are accepted; plugins and DSH tools are trusted, unsandboxed code.
Resumes native DSH context without transcript replay; Paseo retains displayed history.
No raw token deltas, slash commands, steering, plans or terminal UI; real vision/MCP services are untested.
Discovery can leave empty DSH sessions; DSH profiles are authoritative and Paseo's extra system prompt is not injected.
Real macOS daemon turns, full outputs and restart resume passed; desktop UI and native iOS/Android checks remain unverified.
